items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: All 4 ACs met: Python references through shipwright_paths; guard test with reasoned allowlists; DERIVED/RESTORABLE generated from the KIND list; lock_for returns root names. Carriers (bash/YAML/JSON/md) are ratcheted, not rewritten.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Unknown keys raise KeyError with the known list; json_path_or_none keeps the old construction for unknown names; hooks with an ImportError fallback keep their literal fallbacks.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: Stdlib only, no I/O, no subprocess in the resolver; bootstrap appends then removes one sys.path entry derived from __file__.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Frozen pre-resolver names, generated-list equality, scanner shape tests for each reference form, stale-allowlist test; 18 pytest roots run, only pre-existing env failures remain.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: Resolver uses namedtuple (no dataclasses import) so hot-path hooks pay microseconds.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: One module under shared/scripts/lib; scanner split from the test to stay under the file limit; files at their bloat baseline took zero-cost placement.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: Producer/consumer of plugin cache layout probed by mirror tests (design, test, adopt, iterate) plus -I isolated runs of a plugin tool, a shared hook and a stop hook.

items.name: Test Hygiene Probe
items.note: test_hygiene.py over the two new test files: no findings.
